label: Max size per trade
rulesTemplate: Never put more than {value}% of the account into one trade.

label: Daily loss limit
rulesTemplate: Stop trading for the day once losses reach {value}% of the account, and tell the user.

label: Max trades per day
rulesTemplate: Never place more than {value} trades in one day.

label: Leverage cap
rulesTemplate: Never open a position above {value}x leverage.

label: Kelly fraction
rulesTemplate: Size every bet at no more than {value} of the full Kelly stake.

label: Minimum edge
rulesTemplate: Never bet unless your estimated edge over the market price is at least {value}%.

label: Max total exposure
rulesTemplate: Never hold open bets worth more than {value}% of the account in total.

label: Max sends per day
rulesTemplate: Never send more than {value} outbound messages in one day.

label: Refund ceiling
rulesTemplate: Never issue a refund above {value} USD; hand anything larger to the user.
